The supplied excerpts do not show enough of those implementations or the floating-point formatting path to identify a concrete repair.","hypotheses":["Dynamic width parsing or application loses the negative sign's left-alignment meaning, affecting both sequential and positional arguments.","The printf precision handler or its caller maps dynamic precision zero and negative values to one, causing string and floating-point output to retain one character or fractional digit.","Fixed-format floating-point output receives a nonzero precision when the dynamic precision is negative, explaining the extra trailing .0 at large magnitude."] ,"queries":["printf_precision_handler","parse_header","dynamic_width","write_float"],"reads":[{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":75,"symbol":"printf_precision_handler"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":266,"symbol":"parse_header"},{"path":"include/fmt/printf.h","line":341,"symbol":"parse_header"},{"path":"include/fmt/format.h","line":0,"symbol":"write_float"}],"ready":false}
